items.name: resources
items.description: A community-maintained collection of resources for economists applying microeconomic theory, game theory, econometrics, industrial organization, and behavioral economics to the development of AI systems: post-training, alignment, safety, mechanism design for AI, and multi-agent systems.

items.name: sample-agentic-ai-robot
items.description: Agentic AI Robot: Industrial Safety Monitoring and Control

items.name: Industrial-Agents
items.description: This manifesto establishes the definitive requirements for AI agents operating in safety-critical, industrial environments. It distinguishes trustworthy agents that are viable in industrial contexts from general-purpose AI assistants. It also provides the reference framework for evaluating agentic solutions in asset-intensive operations.

items.name: CheckMate
items.description: CheckMate is a real-time IoT-powered smart assistant designed to enhance operator safety and productivity in heavy vehicles. Developed by Team HackaPillar, this project won the CAT Hackathon 2025 for its innovative approach to industrial vehicle monitoring.

items.name: Safe-ZoneAI
items.description: AI-powered safety monitoring system for industrial sites, detecting PPE compliance and unauthorized access in real-time with facial and object recognition.

items.name: SMART-GAS-VALVE-AUTOMATION-AI-POWERED-SAFETY-AND-CONTROL-SYSTEM
items.description: The Smart Gas Valve Automation system is an innovative AI-driven solution designed to enhance the safety, efficiency, and control of gas supply in residential, commercial, and industrial environments. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), and sensor integration.

items.name: NeuroSense-AI-Prototype
items.description: NeuroSense AI: A Cognitive Digital Twin for industrial safety. Using BCI signals (Theta/Beta waves), we predict operator fatigue 3s before accidents. Built with React, TypeScript & Azure for Imagine Cup 2026. Team CodeTitans: Pratik (PMEC) & Sai (OUTR).

items.name: Industrial_Safety_Rover
items.description: An AI-powered industrial safety rover using Raspberry Pi, YOLO, and Flutter to detect worker safety gear (helmets, goggles, etc.) and send real-time alerts..
